nodes.title: Prompt Stash Manager Note
widgets_values:
This is the "Prompt Stash Manager" >>>>>>>>

This allows you to "Stash" prompts that you have created and use them later. I'm using this for the "Img2Text Prompt Nodes" to allow you to create multiple prompts at the same time. It's very easy to use. Type your custom list name in the "New List Name" slot and click "Add" and it will be added to the "Existing Lists" folder. You can then select if from any of the "Prompt Stash Saver" on the workflow.

Tip: I have both positive and negative "Prompt Stash Saver's" in the workflow. I personally use something like "Mountains(Pos)" Or "Mountains(Neg)" for the list name to separate positive and negative prompts.

nodes.title: General Workflow Information Note
widgets_values:
This is a Img2Text (Prompt) to Text2Img Workflow. This workflow allows you to select a image in multiple ways or blinding two image together and get multiple outcomes. If you have a image you would like to get a prompt for and create a new or slightly change image from the original image prompt. This workflow allows you to do that and more. This workflow is broken into 5 Groups, using the "Fast Groups Bypasser (rgthree)" this allows you to basically turn ON and OFF each group. The makes it so unneeded node are no working.
 
This is the Fast Group Bypasser order:

1. Img2Text Prompt Nodes: This is the main set of Node that with create the Img2Text prompts, It has multiple places to add, modify or change text within the prompt. Giving unlimited outcomes.

2. Standard Text2Img Nodes: This is just a regular Text2Img layout with the "Prompt Stash Saver" added and Upscale w/Model 

3. Models (Don't Bypass): Allow to you have multiple models selected or have custom CLIP or VAE with ControlNet selector. It seems to work with SDXL, SD 1.5 and FLUX for me. Do not bypass this group or you will have to reload the models if you use Img2Text or Upscale.

4. Img2Img With Img2Text Prompts Nodes: This allows you to use the "Prompt Stash Saver" to load the saved prompts while using the "ControlNet Preprocessor VAE" and "ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply" to create top tier Img2Img creations. Giving you complete control over the process of how much or how little you want to be changed. (The masking part is not the best masking workflow. But you can use it if you want)

5. Upscaling Img2Img: this is simple Upscale layout. Works well for me personally.

nodes.title: Img2Text Prompt Nodes Note
widgets_values:
This can be a little tricky to learn at first. But it's really simple to use once learned. Here's a set of step you can follow.

1. Use the "Select the image" node to pick which uploaded image you want to use. If you select #2. "Blind Image" you can select the blind factor. This gives a mix prompt from two images.

2. Select which "Florence2ModelLoader" model you wish you use. This is the program the creates the Img2Text Prompt. I normally use the "Florence-2-large-PromptGen-2.0" model

3. Use the "Florence2Run" and select the "Task". This will create the prompts, depending on how detailed you want it. "caption" "detail_caption", "more_detail_caption", prompt_gen_tags, and "prompt_gen_mixed_caption" are the only ones you can really use for this workflow. (You CAN NOT having anything in the text bar or it will not work. This is due to the program itself)

4. Use the "iTools Prompt Styler Extra 🖌️" to add new elements to the prompt outcome. You can add new color, art style, or details to prompt or use the text bar to add something else you want mixed in.

5. Use the "🔤 CR Text Replace" to quickly find and change words you don't want in the prompt outcome. Sometimes useful changing word that are heavily mix into the prompt. (must be add before running the workflow, so run it twice scond time use to cleaning up the prompt)

6. Use the " Prompt Stash Saver" to save your prompts.

The "Prompt Stash Saver" is the second part in the "Stash" for prompts. Copy and Past the "Original Prompt" or "Find & Replace"
into the text bar. Then type a custom file name into the "Save Name" Select which "List" you want it saved under and click "Save Prompt" 

If you want to delete a prompt. Have the prompt loaded wit the "Load Saved" and click "Delete Selected"

Tip: If you are creating a lot of prompts. Give the image itself a custom name and use the image file name as your "Save Name". If you are creating multiple prompts from the same image. I use the "iTools Prompt Styler Extra 🖌️(Template Info For Organization)" node to help with organizing the Prompt Stash Manger. Once you start creating a lot of prompts it can get confusing if you don't. Also using a date as a time stamp can help.

This a simple Text2Img layout with a Model Upscale at the end. I have three multi LoRa nodes. Giving you a opportunity to organize your LoRa's. I you this to create new images from just the prompt only or create a new image and convert that image into a Img2Text prompt.

This on can also be a little tricky to learn at first. But it's really simple to use once learned. Here's a set of step you can follow.

1. Use the "Select the image" node to pick which uploaded image you want to use. If you select 2. "Blind Image" you can select the blind factor this will can give both great and bad outcomes. Look at the ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply" note for more info.

2. IF you want to attempt to use a mask on a image. Use the "Mask Switch" right below this, near the bottom, to choose which image mask you want to use. Then use the bright blue "MASK Latent Switch" node near the center at the bottom. To select if you want to use the mask. This is a hit or miss if the making works properly.

3. Use the "ControlNet Preprocessor VAE" to setup how you want your image used in creating a new image. This basically turns the "Image" itself into another mask. "Canny_Pyra" and "Depth" work the best. But fell free to try them all. If you want a normal Img2Img select "NONE" and you will get it.

4. The "Main Latent Switch" middle right side. Will give you the opportunity use the selected image latent size to the create the new image or you can use the "Empty Latent Image" selector to pick you own image size. (This is the Empty Latent Node I used when creating this. If you want to change it, feel free to change it)

5. Add a LoRa or two to help change the Img2Img outcome. Like background, detailed, body, or really LoRa's can help giving the image you want.


This workflow allows you to get a Prompt from a image and change elements with in the prompt and get good new outcome. Like backgrounds, lighting, hair or skin color while keeping a majority of the image the same. It takes practice to get good. Small changes in the prompt or workflow nodes sometimes can have a major impact and sometimes major changes can have a small impact in the outcome.

The "ControlNetInpaintingAliMamaApply" is one of the main nodes in the full outcome. The strength is like the denoise on standard Img2Img workflows, the strength is 0.00-1.00. If you have 1.00 the image will be fully identical and have zero changes to the image outcome. 0.00 will be a completely new image and only going off of the prompt itself. 

I recommend staying between 0.25-0.75. for most images being created. Sometime you will need to go above or below those numbers.

0.75 will giving very little change, like lighting or more details to person or objects.

0.25 will make major changes but the image concept is the same. Like backgrounds, clothing, skin, hair, while the person can stay the same.
This is a simple Img2Img Upscale layout. It Upscales using a model, then down scales the image and Upscale again giving a nice Upscale outcome.
